description: Macro of a saxophone's brass keys and a man's dark-skinned fingers resting on them, deep violet haze, a cyan and magenta neon grid glinting in reflections on the polished brass, shallow depth of field, anamorphic bokeh. No face in frame. No readable text, letters or logos.
motion: Slow-motion orbit around the saxophone keys as the fingers press them and neon light slides across the brass. One continuous shot, no cuts.

description: A wet city avenue at midnight in the rain, a taxi's red tail lights and passing headlights blurred into the frame, magenta and cyan neon reflected on the glistening asphalt, steam from a grate, anamorphic flares. No people, no readable signs, text or logos: neon is abstract shapes only.
motion: Sideways motion-lapse along the curb as the car light trails stretch into long glowing ribbons through the rain. One continuous shot, no cuts.

description: Low close-up of a still black puddle on night-time city pavement mirroring an abstract magenta and cyan neon tube shape, raindrops just beginning to fall, deep shadows, shallow depth of field. No people. No readable text, letters or logos.
motion: Low underslung glide just above the water as a single raindrop lands and the neon reflection ripples and pulses like a heartbeat. One continuous shot, no cuts.

description: Close-up of a Black woman's hand with warm brown skin, long glossy crimson almond nails and a thin silver bracelet, holding closed the lapel of a midnight-blue velvet blazer draped around her shoulders, the thin strap of a crimson satin slip dress visible beneath, raindrops beading on the velvet, cyan and magenta neon bokeh behind. No face in frame. No readable text or logos.
motion: Steady slow push-in as her fingers tighten on the velvet lapel and raindrops glisten. One continuous shot, no cuts.

description: Seen from behind on a high city rooftop at 3 a.m.: the dark silhouettes of a man and a woman with a very long high ponytail standing close together at the edge, the glowing midnight skyline beyond, light rain catching cyan and magenta neon glow. Faces not visible. No readable text, letters or logos.
motion: Slow rise up from behind the couple as the skyline opens up and her ponytail lifts in the wind. One continuous shot, no cuts.

description: Abstract neon tubes in cyan and magenta mounted on a wet city rooftop at the first blue light of dawn, a soft peach sunrise glowing behind the distant skyline, puddles reflecting the sky. No people. No readable text, letters or logos.
motion: Slow push-in as the neon tubes flicker off one by one and the warm dawn light floods the frame. One continuous shot, no cuts.
